More Than Just A Quality Pool Service! LET US HELP YOU BETTER ENJOY YOUR POOL EXPERIENCE Welcome to AquaJon's Pool Service! Don't let your pool become your second job. Instead, spend your time luxuriating and relaxing in your pool and leave the servicing to AquaJon. We take enormous pride in offering an exemplary service that not only focuses on our customers' happiness but also on their safety. With our weekly service plans, we guarantee a clear and clean pool all year round and we will never just dip and skip. ​ We specialize in turning green pools blue and keeping them that way, but we also offer a wide selection of services from a simple, non-electrical, pump repair to a complete renovation. ​ If you are looking for a service that is top quality while placing safety first, call AquaJon today! ​ (971)-AQUAJON 971.278.2566 ​ Say "Yes" to an AquaJon level of service About Our Company AquaJon's is a small, family operated business owned by Jonathan Ruiz. Jon has over five years of experience mixing, balancing, and neutralizing chemicals. With two small children of his own, he understands the importance and seriousness of keeping a pool chemically balanced and clean so that even the youngest family members can enjoy. ​ At AquaJon's, we have two goals. First, we create and maintain a safe pool environment for your family and friends. Second, you love what we do. We guarantee our customers' satisfaction. If you are not pleased, we offer full refunds or we will promptly return to make any adjustments needed. Our success is your relaxation and enjoyment. Call Us to Schedule a Quote. press to zoom Remodels/Renovations We Can Make any Remodel or Renovation Happen to 100% Satisfaction. press to zoom Repairs If you need help with a water leak, AquaJon can help! press to zoom Services Promotions Our Promotions North Richland Hills Neighborhood Discount-$15 off Weekly Service Package *Cannot be combined with any other discounts or offers.
